backend/main.mo: Main actor defining Task and AdsMetrics types with CRUD operations (addTask, editTask, completeTask, addTaskNotes) and query functions for tasks by phase/milestone; uses Map storage and includes migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms OldActor (with TaskStatus enum) to NewActor (without status field) by mapping old tasks to new Task type, removing the status field while preserving all other data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: replacing status dropdown with checkbox in TaskCard, updating progress calculation for binary completion status, and removing collapsible notes behavior.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components (TaskCard with checkbox, Layout with navigation, MilestoneSection), hooks (useQueries, useTasks), utilities (progressUtils with boolean completion tracking), and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light/dark themes, including phase-specific colors (phase-1 through phase-6) and standard UI element colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish title 'Dashboard de Plan de 90 Días' and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with two routes (Dashboard at '/' and AdsDashboard at '/ads') wrapped in Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component with header showing navigation tabs between Plan de 90 Días and Dashboard ADS, main content area with Outlet, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/MilestoneSection: Expandable milestone card displaying milestone details, date/day ranges, task progress with completion tracking, and list of associated TaskCard components when expanded.
Displays overall project progress with a circular icon, percentage completion, milestone counts, and a progress bar using data from progressUtils.
Renders a grid of clickable phase buttons showing phase number, title, date ranges, and progress bars with milestone completion counts.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Simple badge component that displays either a completed status with checkmark or pending status with circle icon.
frontend/src/components/TaskCard.tsx: Card component for individual tasks with checkbox for completion, editable notes textarea, due date display, and edit button that opens TaskDialog.
frontend/src/components/TaskDialog.tsx: Dialog wrapper component that renders TaskForm in either create or edit mode for managing tasks.
frontend/src/components/TaskForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing tasks with phase/milestone selectors, description input, and due date picker that submits to backend via useTasks hook.
frontend/src/constants/milestones.ts: Defines the complete 6-phase, 18-milestone project structure with detailed metadata including dates, day ranges, descriptions, and content for a legal lead generation business plan.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdsMetrics.ts: React Query hook for fetching all ads metrics and adding new metrics entries (month, spend, leads, appointments, conversions) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: React Query hook for managing tasks with CRUD operations (getAllTasks, addTask, editTask, completeTask, addTaskNotes) using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom warm earth-tone color palette (avoiding blue/purple), defining CSS variables for light/dark themes and phase-specific colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdsDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for tracking monthly advertising metrics (spent, leads, appointments, conversions) with a form to add new metrics and a table displaying calculated KPIs like cost-per-lead and conversion rates.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying a 90-day flight plan with phase navigation, overall progress tracking, milestone sections, and task management dialog for a lead generation system.
frontend/src/utils/adsCalculations.ts: Utility functions for calculating advertising metrics (cost per lead, appointment rate, conversion rate, cost per conversion) and formatting currency/percentage values.
frontend/src/utils/dateUtils.ts: Date utility functions for converting between JavaScript Date and backend Time format (nanoseconds), calculating day numbers within a fixed 90-day period starting February 20, 2026, and formatting dates in Spanish locale.
frontend/src/utils/progressUtils.ts: Utility functions for calculating progress metrics at milestone, phase, and overall levels by analyzing task completion status against defined milestones.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using OKLCH color space, extended theme for container, border radius, shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document defining a Spanish-language 90-day dashboard for a Utah personal injury lead generation system, structured in 6 phases with 18 milestones, tracking web development, chatbots, and paid ads with simple ON/OFF checkbox progress tracking.
